title: Which club will sign Carlos Baleba from Brighton during the 2026 summer transfer window?
background: Carlos Baleba is a Cameroon international midfielder playing for Brighton & Hove Albion in the English Premier League.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official club transfer announcements, corroborated by reputable sports reporting. 
  Resolution Condition : Resolve to the first club publicly confirmed as signing Baleba on a permanent transfer from Brighton during the 2026 summer transfer window. An official signing announcement is sufficient even if administrative registration remains pending. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The destination club's name.
